evidence.text: How can a modular numerical package efficiently approximate Calabi-Yau metrics across complex-structure moduli, helping address the missing metric information needed for low-energy couplings in string compactifications?

sources.title: Towards Systematics of Calabi-Yau Landscape for String Cosmology

evidence.text: How can systematic classification of Calabi–Yau divisor and curve topologies identify geometries suitable for global moduli stabilization and inflation, and how can assisted fibre inflation address geometric field-range constraints?

sources.title: Seeking de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Review how type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifolds can stabilise moduli and realise de Sitter vacua, particularly through purely perturbative corrections, and which geometric requirements permit a concrete global embedding.

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Cutoff from Axions: A Type IIB Landscape Study

evidence.text: Does the proposed bound M_s ≲ 2π√S f survive in Type IIB Calabi–Yau compactifications with multiple axions, especially near Kähler-cone boundaries where electric–magnetic co-scaling fails?

sources.title: Calabi-Yau period geometry and restricted moduli in Type II compactifications

evidence.text: How do Frobenius structure, monodromy and moduli-space symmetries organise Calabi–Yau periods and determine supersymmetric flux vacua on restricted moduli spaces? Applications also include canonical differential systems for Feynman integrals.

sources.title: Calabi-Yau fourfolds for M theory and F theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which explicit Calabi-Yau fourfold deformation families support M- and F-theory compactifications, and how do their topology, instanton divisors, elliptic degenerations, transitions and quantum cohomology encode effective-theory properties?

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Which ten-dimensional equations are retained, assumed, or lost when the generalized functional is restricted to conventional Calabi–Yau light modes?
